_comment: Inputs for prepare_scenario.py. Titles, zone labels and camera labels reach the models, so they stay neutral; everything that names the event lives in the judge-only label/notes/inspection fields, which only land in data/prepared/<id>/expected.json. Times are seconds from the MEVA reference slot start. gt_act_ids are activity ids in the GT camera's kitware annotation (annotation/DIVA-phase-2/MEVA/kitware*/<date>/<hour>/<clip>.activities.yml).

zones.label: Curb and lot east of the bus-station building
Plaza and sidewalk north-west of the bus station
Parking lot north of the bus station
Drive south of the bus station
Access drive between the bus station and the hospital
Road running north-east toward the school

scenarios.title: MEVA KF1 bus station, 2018-03-07 17:01:24
scenarios.notes: Flagship. A grey sedan turns into the curb east of the bus-station building, stops, and a passenger gets out. None of the three visible cameras covers that curb. Dataset labels: vehicle_turns_left, vehicle_stops, vehicle_drops_off_person, person_exits_vehicle (G341). Distractor: cam_b (G436) also shows an unrelated, directly visible drop-off far up its road (white van, people in hi-vis vests; G436 annotation vehicle_drops_off_person about 2-12 s), outside the pocket.

inspection.status: inspection-labeled cue descriptions; the event label itself is annotation-derived

observed.what: grey sedan enters at the bottom of the frame, drives left (west) and leaves the frame
same sedan arrives at the curb east of the bus station and stays stopped to the end of the window; passenger exits from about 19 s
people leave the station door and walk east toward the curb, one carrying a backpack
pedestrians crossing the lot; no view of the curb

inspection.evidence: scratch contact sheets checked frame by frame: sedan last seen in cam_b at about 10 s and first seen in cam_gt at about 12 s; see evidence/contact_sheet.jpg
